skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand the principles and functions of virtualization technologies including hypervisors, system virtualization, and resource management.
Manage and operate different types of hypervisors (Type 1 and Type 2).
Apply concepts of virtual memory, CPU virtualization, and abstract operating systems.
Implement and manage full system virtualization including Type I and Type II virtual machines.
Design and manage virtualized network environments.
Develop strategies for managing storage in virtualized environments.
Understand and apply best practices for virtualizing data centers.
Utilize algorithms for analyzing and solving problems related to virtualization technologies.
Conduct research on virtualization technologies and effectively utilize relevant resources.
